text: ok here is what is happening [Image #96] notice how it just splits right there with a perfect line. seems to be for whatever reason only some of the map can take on the change
resolution: Duplicate capture of the same report as req_2696/req_2697 (the perfect-line split screenshot). One bug, one fix: the pooled ground D buffer cap (GROUND_DATA_FLOATS=20000) truncated the layout-v3 stream's per-cell material tail, so only the first band of each chunk took the picked material. Fixed in aedd40840 — cap raised to the documented v3 worst case (34000) with a loud one-shot error on any future overflow. Verify after a Zig rebuild: paint with a picked material should now cover every stroked tile across the whole chunk.
